[[Ned Buggy]] (2–17) | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1976|1976]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1978|1978]] }} The '''All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship of 1977''' was the 91st staging of [[Ireland]]'s premier [[hurling]] [[single-elimination tournament|knock-out competition]]. [[Cork GAA|Cork]] won the championship, beating [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] 1–17 to 3–8 in the final at [[Croke Park]], [[Dublin]].{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.gaa.ie/videos/1977-all-ireland-senior-hurling-championship-final |title=1977 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final |date=2024-01-25 |last= |type=Video |language=en |access-date=2024-12-06 |via=Gaa.ie}}{{Cite web |last= |date=2020-05-06 |title=Flashback: 1977 All Ireland SHC Final – Cork v Wexford |url=https://www.gaa.ie/hurling/news/flashback-1977-all-ireland-shc-final-cork-v-wexford |access-date=2024-12-06 |website=Gaa.ie |language=en}} ==The championship== ===Format=== '''Munster Championship''' ''First round:'' (1 match) This is a single match between the first two teams drawn from the province of Munster. One team is eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the semi-finals. ''Semi-finals:'' (2 matches) The winner of the first round joins the other three Munster teams to make up the semi-final pairings. Two teams are eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the final. ''Final:'' (1 match) The winner of the two semi-finals contest this game. One team is eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the All-Ireland semi-final. '''Leinster Championship''' ''First round:'' (2 matches) These are two matches between the first four teams drawn from the province of Leinster. Two teams are eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the semi-finals. ''Semi-finals:'' (2 matches) The winners of the two first-round games join the other two Leinster teams to make up the semi-final pairings. Two teams are eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the final. ''Final:'' (1 match) The winners of the two semi-finals contest this game. One team is eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the All-Ireland final. '''All-Ireland Championship''' ''Quarter-final:'' (1 match) This is a single match between Galway and the winners of the All-Ireland 'B' championship. One team is eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the semi-final. ''Semi-final:'' (1 match) This is a single match between the Munster champions and the winners of the quarter-final. One team is eliminated at this stage while the winners advance to the final. ''Final:'' (1 match) The winners of the semi-final and the Leinster champions contest this game. ==Provincial championships== ===[[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{footballbox | |date = June 5
